import std/[json, options, os, strutils, sequtils, httpclient, random, times]

randomize()

const
  RetryMaxRetries* = 4
  RetryBaseDelayMs* = 500
  RetryMaxDelayMs* = 30_000

type
  Role* = enum
    roleSystem,
    roleUser,
    roleAssistant,
    roleTool,
    roleFunction

  MessageContentKind* = enum
    mckString,
    mckText,
    mckImage,
    mckFile

  MessageContent* = object
    case kind*: MessageContentKind
    of mckString, mckText:
      text*: string
    of mckImage:
      imageUrl*: string
      detail*: Option[string]
    of mckFile:
      fileUrl*: string
      mimeType*: Option[string]

  Message* = object
    role*: Role
    content*: seq[MessageContent]
    name*: Option[string]
    toolCallId*: Option[string]

  Tool* = object
    name*: string
    description*: Option[string]
    parameters*: Option[JsonNode]

  ToolChoiceKind* = enum
    tckNone,
    tckAuto,
    tckRequired,
    tckByName,
    tckExplicit

  ToolChoice* = object
    case kind*: ToolChoiceKind
    of tckByName, tckExplicit:
      name*: string
    else:
      discard

  JsonSchema* = object
    name*: string
    schema*: JsonNode
    strict*: Option[bool]

  OutputSchema* = JsonSchema

  ResponseFormatKind* = enum
    rfText,
    rfJsonObject,
    rfJsonSchema

  ResponseFormat* = object
    case kind*: ResponseFormatKind
    of rfJsonSchema:
      jsonSchema*: JsonSchema
    else:
      discard

  InvokeParams* = object
    messages*: seq[Message]
    tools*: seq[Tool]
    toolChoice*: Option[ToolChoice]
    maxTokens*: Option[int]
    outputSchema*: Option[OutputSchema]
    responseFormat*: Option[ResponseFormat]
    model*: Option[string]
    thinking*: Option[JsonNode]
    reasoning*: Option[JsonNode]

  ToolCall* = object
    id*: string
    kind*: string
    functionName*: string
    arguments*: string

  InvokeChoiceMessage* = object
    role*: Role
    content*: JsonNode
    toolCalls*: seq[ToolCall]

  InvokeChoice* = object
    index*: int
    message*: InvokeChoiceMessage
    finishReason*: Option[string]

  Usage* = object
    promptTokens*: int
    completionTokens*: int
    totalTokens*: int

  InvokeResult* = object
    id*: string
    created*: int64
    model*: string
    choices*: seq[InvokeChoice]
    usage*: Option[Usage]

  ModelInfo* = object
    id*: string
    objectKind*: string
    created*: int64
    ownedBy*: string

  ModelsResponse* = object
    objectKind*: string
    data*: seq[ModelInfo]

  RequestInit* = object
    httpMethod*: HttpMethod
    headers*: seq[(string, string)]
    body*: string

  ResponseData* = object
    statusCode*: int
    statusText*: string
    body*: string

proc roleToString*(role: Role): string =
  case role
  of roleSystem: "system"
  of roleUser: "user"
  of roleAssistant: "assistant"
  of roleTool: "tool"
  of roleFunction: "function"

proc parseRole*(value: string): Role =
  case value
  of "system": roleSystem
  of "user": roleUser
  of "assistant": roleAssistant
  of "tool": roleTool
  of "function": roleFunction
  else: raise newException(ValueError, "Unsupported role: " & value)

proc stringContent*(text: string): MessageContent =
  MessageContent(kind: mckString, text: text)

proc textContent*(text: string): MessageContent =
  MessageContent(kind: mckText, text: text)

proc imageContent*(url: string; detail = ""): MessageContent =
  result = MessageContent(kind: mckImage, imageUrl: url)
  if detail.len > 0:
    result.detail = some(detail)

proc fileContent*(url: string; mimeType = ""): MessageContent =
  result = MessageContent(kind: mckFile, fileUrl: url)
  if mimeType.len > 0:
    result.mimeType = some(mimeType)

proc newMessage*(role: Role; content: varargs[MessageContent]): Message =
  Message(role: role, content: @content)

proc newTool*(name: string; description = ""; parameters: JsonNode = nil): Tool =
  result = Tool(name: name)
  if description.len > 0:
    result.description = some(description)
  if not parameters.isNil:
    result.parameters = some(parameters)

proc toolChoiceNone*(): ToolChoice =
  ToolChoice(kind: tckNone)

proc toolChoiceAuto*(): ToolChoice =
  ToolChoice(kind: tckAuto)

proc toolChoiceRequired*(): ToolChoice =
  ToolChoice(kind: tckRequired)

proc toolChoiceByName*(name: string): ToolChoice =
  ToolChoice(kind: tckByName, name: name)

proc toolChoiceExplicit*(name: string): ToolChoice =
  ToolChoice(kind: tckExplicit, name: name)

proc textResponseFormat*(): ResponseFormat =
  ResponseFormat(kind: rfText)

proc jsonObjectResponseFormat*(): ResponseFormat =
  ResponseFormat(kind: rfJsonObject)

proc jsonSchemaResponseFormat*(schema: JsonSchema): ResponseFormat =
  ResponseFormat(kind: rfJsonSchema, jsonSchema: schema)

proc isOk*(response: ResponseData): bool =
  response.statusCode in 200 .. 299

proc stripTrailingSlashes(value: string): string =
  result = value
  while result.len > 0 and result == '/':
    result.setLen(result.len - 1)

proc lookupEnv(keys: openArray[string]): string =
  for key in keys:
    let value = getEnv(key, "")
    if value.len > 0:
      return value
  ""

proc forgeApiUrlEnv(): string =
  lookupEnv(["FORGE_API_URL", "forgeApiUrl"])

proc forgeApiKeyEnv(): string =
  lookupEnv(["FORGE_API_KEY", "forgeApiKey"])

proc resolveApiUrl*(): string =
  let base = forgeApiUrlEnv().strip()
  if base.len > 0:
    stripTrailingSlashes(base) & "/v1/chat/completions"
  else:
    ""

proc resolveModelsUrl*(): string =
  let base = forgeApiUrlEnv().strip()
  if base.len > 0:
    stripTrailingSlashes(base) & "/v1/models"
  else:
    ""

proc assertApiKey*() =
  if forgeApiKeyEnv().len == 0:
    raise newException(ValueError, "forgeApiKey is not configured")

proc newJArrayFrom(items: seq[JsonNode]): JsonNode =
  result = newJArray()
  for item in items:
    result.add(item)

proc messageContentToJson(part: MessageContent): JsonNode =
  result = newJObject()
  case part.kind
  of mckString, mckText:
    result["type"] = %"text"
    result["text"] = %part.text
  of mckImage:
    var payload = newJObject()
    payload["url"] = %part.imageUrl
    if part.detail.isSome:
      payload["detail"] = %part.detail.get()
    result["type"] = %"image_url"
    result["image_url"] = payload
  of mckFile:
    var payload = newJObject()
    payload["url"] = %part.fileUrl
    if part.mimeType.isSome:
      payload["mime_type"] = %part.mimeType.get()
    result["type"] = %"file_url"
    result["file_url"] = payload

proc normalizeMessage*(message: Message): JsonNode =
  result = newJObject()
  result["role"] = %roleToString(message.role)
  if message.name.isSome:
    result["name"] = %message.name.get()

  if message.role in {roleTool, roleFunction}:
    if message.toolCallId.isSome:
      result["tool_call_id"] = %message.toolCallId.get()
    let pieces = message.content.mapIt(
      case it.kind
      of mckString:
        it.text
      else:
        $messageContentToJson(it)
    )
    result["content"] = %pieces.join("\n")
    return

  let contentParts = message.content.mapIt(messageContentToJson(it))
  if contentParts.len == 1 and contentParts.kind == JObject and contentParts.hasKey("type") and contentParts["type"].getStr() == "text":
    result["content"] = contentParts["text"]
  else:
    result["content"] = newJArrayFrom(contentParts)

proc toolToJson(tool: Tool): JsonNode =
  result = newJObject()
  result["type"] = %"function"
  var fn = newJObject()
  fn["name"] = %tool.name
  if tool.description.isSome:
    fn["description"] = %tool.description.get()
  if tool.parameters.isSome:
    fn["parameters"] = tool.parameters.get()
  result["function"] = fn

proc explicitToolChoiceNode(name: string): JsonNode =
  result = newJObject()
  result["type"] = %"function"
  var fn = newJObject()
  fn["name"] = %name
  result["function"] = fn

proc normalizeToolChoice*(toolChoice: Option[ToolChoice]; tools: seq[Tool]): Option[JsonNode] =
  if toolChoice.isNone:
    return none(JsonNode)

  let choice = toolChoice.get()
  case choice.kind
  of tckNone:
    some(% "none")
  of tckAuto:
    some(% "auto")
  of tckRequired:
    if tools.len == 0:
      raise newException(ValueError, "tool_choice 'required' was provided but no tools were configured")
    if tools.len > 1:
      raise newException(ValueError, "tool_choice 'required' needs a single tool or specify the tool name explicitly")
    some(explicitToolChoiceNode(tools.name))
  of tckByName, tckExplicit:
    some(explicitToolChoiceNode(choice.name))

proc jsonSchemaToJson(schema: JsonSchema): JsonNode =
  result = newJObject()
  result["name"] = %schema.name
  result["schema"] = schema.schema
  if schema.strict.isSome:
    result["strict"] = %schema.strict.get()

proc normalizeResponseFormat*(
  responseFormat: Option[ResponseFormat];
  outputSchema: Option[OutputSchema]
): Option[JsonNode] =
  if responseFormat.isSome:
    let explicitFormat = responseFormat.get()
    case explicitFormat.kind
    of rfText:
      var node = newJObject()
      node["type"] = %"text"
      return some(node)
    of rfJsonObject:
      var node = newJObject()
      node["type"] = %"json_object"
      return some(node)
    of rfJsonSchema:
      if explicitFormat.jsonSchema.schema.isNil or explicitFormat.jsonSchema.schema.kind == JNull:
        raise newException(ValueError, "responseFormat json_schema requires a defined schema object")
      var node = newJObject()
      node["type"] = %"json_schema"
      node["json_schema"] = jsonSchemaToJson(explicitFormat.jsonSchema)
      return some(node)

  if outputSchema.isNone:
    return none(JsonNode)

  let schema = outputSchema.get()
  if schema.name.len == 0 or schema.schema.isNil or schema.schema.kind == JNull:
    raise newException(ValueError, "outputSchema requires both name and schema")

  var node = newJObject()
  node["type"] = %"json_schema"
  node["json_schema"] = jsonSchemaToJson(schema)
  some(node)

proc sleepMs(ms: int) =
  if ms > 0:
    sleep(ms)

proc parseRetryAfter*(value: string): Option[int] =
  let stripped = value.strip()
  if stripped.len == 0:
    return none(int)

  try:
    let seconds = parseFloat(stripped)
    return some(max(0, int(seconds * 1000.0)))
  except ValueError:
    discard

  try:
    let retryAt = parse(stripped, "ddd, dd MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss 'GMT'", utc())
    let nowUtc = now(utc())
    let delta = retryAt - nowUtc
    return some(max(0, int(delta.inMilliseconds)))
  except CatchableError:
    discard

  none(int)

proc computeBackoffDelay*(attempt: int; retryAfterMs: Option[int] = none(int)): int =
  let cap = min(RetryBaseDelayMs * (1 shl attempt), RetryMaxDelayMs)
  let half = max(1, cap div 2)
  let jittered = half + rand(half)
  let floorValue = if retryAfterMs.isSome: retryAfterMs.get() else: 0
  min(max(jittered, floorValue), RetryMaxDelayMs)

proc fetchWithBackoff*(url: string; init: RequestInit): ResponseData =
  var lastError: ref CatchableError

  for attempt in 0 .. RetryMaxRetries:
    try:
      var client = newHttpClient()
      defer:
        client.close()

      client.headers = newHttpHeaders()
      for (key, value) in init.headers:
        client.headers[key] = value

      let response = client.request(url, httpMethod = init.httpMethod, body = init.body)
      let data = ResponseData(
        statusCode: int(response.code),
        statusText: $response.code,
        body: response.body
      )

      if data.isOk or attempt == RetryMaxRetries:
        return data

      sleepMs(computeBackoffDelay(attempt))
    except CatchableError as err:
      lastError = err
      if attempt == RetryMaxRetries:
        raise
      sleepMs(computeBackoffDelay(attempt))

  if lastError != nil:
    raise lastError
  raise newException(IOError, "LLM request failed after exhausting retries")

proc getStringField(node: JsonNode; key: string; default = ""): string =
  if node.kind == JObject and node.hasKey(key) and node[key].kind != JNull:
    node[key].getStr()
  else:
    default

proc getIntField(node: JsonNode; key: string; default = 0): int =
  if node.kind == JObject and node.hasKey(key) and node[key].kind != JNull:
    node[key].getInt()
  else:
    default

proc getInt64Field(node: JsonNode; key: string; default = 0'i64): int64 =
  if node.kind == JObject and node.hasKey(key) and node[key].kind != JNull:
    node[key].getInt().int64
  else:
    default

proc parseToolCall(node: JsonNode): ToolCall =
  let fnNode =
    if node.kind == JObject and node.hasKey("function") and node["function"].kind == JObject:
      node["function"]
    else:
      newJObject()

  ToolCall(
    id: getStringField(node, "id"),
    kind: getStringField(node, "type"),
    functionName: getStringField(fnNode, "name"),
    arguments: getStringField(fnNode, "arguments")
  )

proc parseInvokeChoiceMessage(node: JsonNode): InvokeChoiceMessage =
  result.role = parseRole(getStringField(node, "role"))
  if node.kind == JObject and node.hasKey("content"):
    result.content = node["content"]
  else:
    result.content = newJNull()

  if node.kind == JObject and node.hasKey("tool_calls") and node["tool_calls"].kind == JArray:
    for item in node["tool_calls"].items:
      result.toolCalls.add(parseToolCall(item))

proc parseInvokeChoice(node: JsonNode): InvokeChoice =
  result.index = getIntField(node, "index")
  if node.kind == JObject and node.hasKey("message") and node["message"].kind == JObject:
    result.message = parseInvokeChoiceMessage(node["message"])
  if node.kind == JObject and node.hasKey("finish_reason") and node["finish_reason"].kind != JNull:
    result.finishReason = some(node["finish_reason"].getStr())

proc parseUsage(node: JsonNode): Usage =
  Usage(
    promptTokens: getIntField(node, "prompt_tokens"),
    completionTokens: getIntField(node, "completion_tokens"),
    totalTokens: getIntField(node, "total_tokens")
  )

proc parseInvokeResult*(node: JsonNode): InvokeResult =
  result.id = getStringField(node, "id")
  result.created = getInt64Field(node, "created")
  result.model = getStringField(node, "model")

  if node.kind == JObject and node.hasKey("choices") and node["choices"].kind == JArray:
    for item in node["choices"].items:
      result.choices.add(parseInvokeChoice(item))

  if node.kind == JObject and node.hasKey("usage") and node["usage"].kind == JObject:
    result.usage = some(parseUsage(node["usage"]))

proc invokeLLM*(params: InvokeParams): InvokeResult =
  assertApiKey()

  var payload = newJObject()
  payload["messages"] = newJArrayFrom(params.messages.mapIt(normalizeMessage(it)))

  if params.model.isSome:
    payload["model"] = %params.model.get()

  if params.tools.len > 0:
    payload["tools"] = newJArrayFrom(params.tools.mapIt(toolToJson(it)))

  let normalizedToolChoice = normalizeToolChoice(params.toolChoice, params.tools)
  if normalizedToolChoice.isSome:
    payload["tool_choice"] = normalizedToolChoice.get()

  if params.maxTokens.isSome:
    payload["max_tokens"] = %params.maxTokens.get()

  if params.thinking.isSome:
    payload["thinking"] = params.thinking.get()

  if params.reasoning.isSome:
    payload["reasoning"] = params.reasoning.get()

  let normalizedResponseFormat = normalizeResponseFormat(params.responseFormat, params.outputSchema)
  if normalizedResponseFormat.isSome:
    payload["response_format"] = normalizedResponseFormat.get()

  let response = fetchWithBackoff(
    resolveApiUrl(),
    RequestInit(
      httpMethod: HttpPost,
      headers: @[
        ("content-type", "application/json"),
        ("authorization", "Bearer " & forgeApiKeyEnv())
      ],
      body: $payload
    )
  )

  if not response.isOk:
    raise newException(
      IOError,
      "LLM invoke failed: " & $response.statusCode & " " & response.statusText & " – " & response.body
    )

  parseInvokeResult(parseJson(response.body))

proc parseModelInfo(node: JsonNode): ModelInfo =
  ModelInfo(
    id: getStringField(node, "id"),
    objectKind: getStringField(node, "object"),
    created: getInt64Field(node, "created"),
    ownedBy: getStringField(node, "owned_by")
  )

proc parseModelsResponse*(node: JsonNode): ModelsResponse =
  result.objectKind = getStringField(node, "object")
  if node.kind == JObject and node.hasKey("data") and node["data"].kind == JArray:
    for item in node["data"].items:
      result.data.add(parseModelInfo(item))

proc listLLMModels*(): ModelsResponse =
  assertApiKey()

  let response = fetchWithBackoff(
    resolveModelsUrl(),
    RequestInit(
      httpMethod: HttpGet,
      headers: @[("authorization", "Bearer " & forgeApiKeyEnv())]
    )
  )

  if not response.isOk:
    raise newException(
      IOError,
      "List LLM models failed: " & $response.statusCode & " " & response.statusText & " – " & response.body
    )

  parseModelsResponse(parseJson(response.body))

when isMainModule:
  discard

    result["image_url"] = imageNode
  of mckFile:
    var fileNode = newJObject()
    fileNode["url"] = %part.fileUrl
    if part.mimeType.isSome:
      fileNode["mime_type"] = %part.mimeType.get()
    result["type"] = %"file_url"
    result["file_url"] = fileNode

proc normalizeMessage*(message: Message): JsonNode =
  result = newJObject()
  result["role"] = %roleToString(message.role)
  if message.name.isSome:
    result["name"] = %message.name.get()

  if message.role in {roleTool, roleFunction}:
    if message.toolCallId.isSome:
      result["tool_call_id"] = %message.toolCallId.get()
    let contentPieces = message.content.mapIt(
      if it.kind == mckString:
        it.text
      else:
        $messageContentToJson(it)
    )
    result["content"] = %contentPieces.join("\n")
    return

  let contentParts = message.content.mapIt(messageContentToJson(it))
  if contentParts.len == 1 and contentParts[0].kind == JObject and contentParts[0].hasKey("type") and contentParts[0]["type"].getStr() == "text":
    result["content"] = contentParts[0]["text"]
  else:
    result["content"] = newJArrayFrom(contentParts)

proc toolToJson(tool: Tool): JsonNode =
  result = newJObject()
  result["type"] = %"function"
  var functionNode = newJObject()
  functionNode["name"] = %tool.name
  if tool.description.isSome:
    functionNode["description"] = %tool.description.get()
  if tool.parameters.isSome:
    functionNode["parameters"] = tool.parameters.get()
  result["function"] = functionNode

proc explicitToolChoiceNode(name: string): JsonNode =
  result = newJObject()
  result["type"] = %"function"
  var functionNode = newJObject()
  functionNode["name"] = %name
  result["function"] = functionNode

proc normalizeToolChoice*(toolChoice: Option[ToolChoice]; tools: seq[Tool]): Option[JsonNode] =
  if toolChoice.isNone:
    return none(JsonNode)

  let value = toolChoice.get()
  case value.kind
  of tckNone:
    some(%"none")
  of tckAuto:
    some(%"auto")
  of tckRequired:
    if tools.len == 0:
      raise newException(ValueError, "tool_choice 'required' was provided but no tools were configured")
    if tools.len > 1:
      raise newException(ValueError, "tool_choice 'required' needs a single tool or specify the tool name explicitly")
    some(explicitToolChoiceNode(tools[0].name))
  of tckByName, tckExplicit:
    some(explicitToolChoiceNode(value.name))

proc jsonSchemaToJson(schema: JsonSchema): JsonNode =
  result = newJObject()
  result["name"] = %schema.name
  result["schema"] = schema.schema
  if schema.strict.isSome:
    result["strict"] = %schema.strict.get()

proc normalizeResponseFormat*(responseFormat: Option[ResponseFormat]; outputSchema: Option[OutputSchema]): Option[JsonNode] =
  if responseFormat.isSome:
    let explicitFormat = responseFormat.get()
    case explicitFormat.kind
    of rfText:
      var node = newJObject()
      node["type"] = %"text"
      return some(node)
    of rfJsonObject:
      var node = newJObject()
      node["type"] = %"json_object"
      return some(node)
    of rfJsonSchema:
      if explicitFormat.jsonSchema.name.len == 0 or explicitFormat.jsonSchema.schema.isNil or explicitFormat.jsonSchema.schema.kind == JNull:
        raise newException(ValueError, "responseFormat json_schema requires a defined schema object")
      var node = newJObject()
      node["type"] = %"json_schema"
      node["json_schema"] = jsonSchemaToJson(explicitFormat.jsonSchema)
      return some(node)

  if outputSchema.isNone:
    return none(JsonNode)

  let schema = outputSchema.get()
  if schema.name.len == 0 or schema.schema.isNil or schema.schema.kind == JNull:
    raise newException(ValueError, "outputSchema requires both name and schema")

  var node = newJObject()
  node["type"] = %"json_schema"
  node["json_schema"] = jsonSchemaToJson(schema)
  some(node)

proc sleepMs(ms: int) =
  if ms > 0:
    sleep(ms)

proc parseRetryAfter*(value: string): Option[int] =
  let stripped = value.strip()
  if stripped.len == 0:
    return none(int)

  try:
    let seconds = parseFloat(stripped)
    return some(max(0, int(seconds * 1000.0)))
  except ValueError:
    discard

  try:
    let retryAt = parse(stripped, "ddd, dd MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss 'GMT'", utc())
    let delta = retryAt - now(utc())
    return some(max(0, int(delta.inMilliseconds)))
  except CatchableError:
    discard

  none(int)

proc computeBackoffDelay*(attempt: int; retryAfterMs: Option[int] = none(int)): int =
  let cap = min(RetryBaseDelayMs * (1 shl attempt), RetryMaxDelayMs)
  let lowerBound = max(1, cap div 2)
  let jittered = lowerBound + rand(cap - lowerBound)
  let floorValue = if retryAfterMs.isSome: retryAfterMs.get() else: 0
  min(max(jittered, floorValue), RetryMaxDelayMs)

proc headerOrEmpty(headers: HttpHeaders; key: string): string =
  try:
    headers.getOrDefault(key)
  except CatchableError:
    ""

proc fetchWithBackoff*(url: string; init: RequestInit): ResponseData =
  var lastError: ref CatchableError = nil

  for attempt in 0 .. RetryMaxRetries:
    try:
      var client = newHttpClient()
      defer:
        client.close()

      client.headers = newHttpHeaders()
      for header in init.headers:
        client.headers[header[0]] = header[1]

      let response = client.request(url, httpMethod = init.httpMethod, body = init.body)
      let retryAfterValue = headerOrEmpty(response.headers, "retry-after")
      let data = ResponseData(
        statusCode: response.code.int,
        statusText: response.status,
        body: response.body,
        retryAfter: if retryAfterValue.len > 0: some(retryAfterValue) else: none(string)
      )

      if data.isOk or attempt == RetryMaxRetries:
        return data

      let retryAfterMs = if data.retryAfter.isSome: parseRetryAfter(data.retryAfter.get()) else: none(int)
      sleepMs(computeBackoffDelay(attempt, retryAfterMs))
    except CatchableError as err:
      lastError = err
      if attempt == RetryMaxRetries:
        raise
      sleepMs(computeBackoffDelay(attempt))

  if lastError != nil:
    raise lastError
  raise newException(IOError, "LLM request failed after exhausting retries")

proc getStringField(node: JsonNode; key: string; defaultValue = ""): string =
  if node.kind == JObject and node.hasKey(key) and node[key].kind != JNull:
    node[key].getStr()
  else:
    defaultValue

proc getIntField(node: JsonNode; key: string; defaultValue = 0): int =
  if node.kind == JObject and node.hasKey(key) and node[key].kind != JNull:
    node[key].getInt()
  else:
    defaultValue

proc getInt64Field(node: JsonNode; key: string; defaultValue = 0'i64): int64 =
  if node.kind == JObject and node.hasKey(key) and node[key].kind != JNull:
    int64(node[key].getBiggestInt())
  else:
    defaultValue

proc parseToolCall(node: JsonNode): ToolCall =
  let functionNode = if node.kind == JObject and node.hasKey("function") and node["function"].kind == JObject: node["function"] else: newJObject()
  ToolCall(
    id: getStringField(node, "id"),
    kind: getStringField(node, "type"),
    functionName: getStringField(functionNode, "name"),
    arguments: getStringField(functionNode, "arguments")
  )

proc parseInvokeChoiceMessage(node: JsonNode): InvokeChoiceMessage =
  result.role = parseRole(getStringField(node, "role"))
  if node.kind == JObject and node.hasKey("content"):
    result.content = node["content"]
  else:
    result.content = newJNull()
  if node.kind == JObject and node.hasKey("tool_calls") and node["tool_calls"].kind == JArray:
    for item in node["tool_calls"].items:
      result.toolCalls.add(parseToolCall(item))

proc parseInvokeChoice(node: JsonNode): InvokeChoice =
  result.index = getIntField(node, "index")
  if node.kind == JObject and node.hasKey("message") and node["message"].kind == JObject:
    result.message = parseInvokeChoiceMessage(node["message"])
  else:
    result.message = InvokeChoiceMessage(role: roleAssistant, content: newJNull(), toolCalls: @[])
  if node.kind == JObject and node.hasKey("finish_reason") and node["finish_reason"].kind != JNull:
    result.finishReason = some(node["finish_reason"].getStr())
  else:
    result.finishReason = none(string)

proc parseUsage(node: JsonNode): Usage =
  Usage(
    promptTokens: getIntField(node, "prompt_tokens"),
    completionTokens: getIntField(node, "completion_tokens"),
    totalTokens: getIntField(node, "total_tokens")
  )

proc parseInvokeResult*(node: JsonNode): InvokeResult =
  result.id = getStringField(node, "id")
  result.created = getInt64Field(node, "created")
  result.model = getStringField(node, "model")
  if node.kind == JObject and node.hasKey("choices") and node["choices"].kind == JArray:
    for item in node["choices"].items:
      result.choices.add(parseInvokeChoice(item))
  if node.kind == JObject and node.hasKey("usage") and node["usage"].kind == JObject:
    result.usage = some(parseUsage(node["usage"]))
  else:
    result.usage = none(Usage)

proc invokeLLM*(params: InvokeParams): InvokeResult =
  assertApiKey()

  var payload = newJObject()
  payload["messages"] = newJArrayFrom(params.messages.mapIt(normalizeMessage(it)))

  if params.model.isSome:
    payload["model"] = %params.model.get()

  if params.tools.len > 0:
    payload["tools"] = newJArrayFrom(params.tools.mapIt(toolToJson(it)))

  let normalizedToolChoice = normalizeToolChoice(params.toolChoice, params.tools)
  if normalizedToolChoice.isSome:
    payload["tool_choice"] = normalizedToolChoice.get()

  if params.maxTokens.isSome:
    payload["max_tokens"] = %params.maxTokens.get()

  if params.thinking.isSome:
    payload["thinking"] = params.thinking.get()

  if params.reasoning.isSome:
    payload["reasoning"] = params.reasoning.get()

  let normalizedResponseFormat = normalizeResponseFormat(params.responseFormat, params.outputSchema)
  if normalizedResponseFormat.isSome:
    payload["response_format"] = normalizedResponseFormat.get()

  let response = fetchWithBackoff(
    resolveApiUrl(),
    RequestInit(
      httpMethod: HttpPost,
      headers: @[
        ("content-type", "application/json"),
        ("authorization", "Bearer " & ENV.forgeApiKey)
      ],
      body: $payload
    )
  )

  if not response.isOk:
    raise newException(IOError, "LLM invoke failed: " & $response.statusCode & " " & response.statusText & " – " & response.body)

  parseInvokeResult(parseJson(response.body))

proc parseModelInfo(node: JsonNode): ModelInfo =
  ModelInfo(
    id: getStringField(node, "id"),
    objectKind: getStringField(node, "object"),
    created: getInt64Field(node, "created"),
    ownedBy: getStringField(node, "owned_by")
  )

proc parseModelsResponse*(node: JsonNode): ModelsResponse =
  result.objectKind = getStringField(node, "object")
  if node.kind == JObject and node.hasKey("data") and node["data"].kind == JArray:
    for item in node["data"].items:
      result.data.add(parseModelInfo(item))

proc listLLMModels*(): ModelsResponse =
  assertApiKey()

  let response = fetchWithBackoff(
    resolveModelsUrl(),
    RequestInit(
      httpMethod: HttpGet,
      headers: @[("authorization", "Bearer " & ENV.forgeApiKey)],
      body: ""
    )
  )

  if not response.isOk:
    raise newException(IOError, "List LLM models failed: " & $response.statusCode & " " & response.statusText & " – " & response.body)

  parseModelsResponse(parseJson(response.body))

  discard
